notes.title: Interloper Libraries Update! (Gold 1.1.2)
notes.notes:
- We've built a latest version of the Lidgren library for networking, which might resolve some connectivity issues (no issues targeted in particular, just the hope that a newer build is more stable).

- We've built the latest version of FNA for the OSx and Linux builds. This might help with the OSx retina display bug where your cursor is completely offset from your ingame cursor. I don't have a retina Mac myself, so if anyone could confirm/deny this that would be great :)

notes.title: Interloper Anniversary Update! (gold 1.1.0)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8690826/d3dd901dc0e415403fcc2c71f913a7ed4e1f7a61.png[/img]

Interloper is 1 year old today! To celebrate we worked on an update featuring new content, leaderboards and more. Check out the lists below to see exactly what is new and what has changed.

New Features:
[list]
[*]Map-specialist AI type (AI that learned from the best players)
[*]2 new skirmish/multiplayer maps (High Ground and Segregation)
[*]Weekly and Daily best player leaderboards (Players with the biggest increase in ELO during these periods of time)
[*]Color blind modes (protanope, deuteranope, tritanope)
[*]Italian translation (Thanks to Krahos <3)
[*]Replay code now visible in replays (For easier sharing :)
[/list]

Fixes, Improvements and Changes:
[list]
[*]Player wins when opponent has no domain left
[*]Snipers and Destroyers spawn uncharged when made in a Foundry
[*]Improved multiplayer for Linux users
[*]Fixed crash when loading too many replays
[*]Replays start at the point where both players have moved
[*]Improved menu graphics
[list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.8! ^^3
notes.notes:
Retina fix and Portuguese language support!

[b]Update gold 1.0.8[/b]

New stuff
[list]
[*]Portuguese (PT) translation![/list]
Fixes
[list]
[*]Memory optimization
[*]Capped resolution on 4096 (sorry guys, XNA render targets don't go bigger than that... So no retina support, but also no more retina glitches/crashes!!)
[*]Renamed Campaign AI to 'Campaign (AI)' instead of full path
[*]Fixed sound of previous match continue playing when starting online match[/list]

Hope that helps :)

notes.title: Update 1.0.7 :O good stuff!
notes.notes:
3 updates in 1!

[b]Update gold 1.0.7[/b]

New stuff
[list]
[*]You can now play skirmish matches while waiting to connect
[*]You can now pick replays from the replay frame while waiting to connect[/list]
Fixes
[list]
[*]Added some safety to loading replays
[*]Fixed file paths (should hopefully fix 'can't find content' crashes)
[*]Small memory optimization (should help reduce the 'out of memory' exceptions)
[*]Fixed some textbox bugs[/list]

Biggest change: you can play skirmish matches while queuing! Go go go! Populate that fucking queue go! LESGO! :D

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Small quick fixes

[b]Update gold 1.0.4[/b]

New stuff
[list]
[*]When setting back an opponent you also send a position message.
[*]Made it so your path doesn't clear when you get set back.[/list]
Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed credit frame size (all credits fit now :)
[*]Removed exception when double initing or deiniting (this should not happen, but crashing the game is a bit too harsh)
[*]Made moveCharacterMSG not be filtered out when match hasn't started. This should fix the lag stutter you always see when a match starts.
[*]Setback checks are now only performed on local units. (A local unit can still set back a nonlocal unit though!)
[*]Made sure your name doesn't get set to Stranger when it's been something else before.[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 :D
notes.notes:
You guys wanted key bindings, well here you go!

[b]Update gold 1.0.3![/b]

New stuff
[list]
[*]Added UPnP port forwarding for routers that support UPnP (seems to only work on Windows for now :/)
[*]Made port fixed on 52540 (can now be changed in settings file)
[*]Added control rebinding in controls settings (Cause y'all asked for it! :)
[*]Added player names to the top of a match
[*]Added waiting animation when watching a reply while looking for match (so you can see you're still waiting to connect)
[*]Added some more people to the special thanks in the credits :3[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed ELO loss on instant disconnect after rematch (sorry about that!)
[*]Fixed replay not refreshing in connecting menu when waiting for connection
[*]Fixed replays with 'bad' starts
[*]Fixed set path sound effect playing during replay
[*]Added some more checks for Steam API usage if Steam actually works[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1!
notes.notes:
The first patch is out. Here are the changes:

New Stuff:[list]
[*]Added top 50 view to leaderboard
[*]Better multi-monitor support
[*]Made [b]OSx[/b] and [b]Linux[/b] game start at 800x600 resolution (to be sure OSx and Linux users don't get unplayable resolutions)
[*]Made credits pretier :3
[*]Added timer to unbuilt structure hint, so that it doesn't stay on-screen forever.
[*]You can now change your name in the menu[/list]
Fixes:[list]
[*]Fixed hangup on upload replay
[*]Fixed rematch disconnect bug (aka ELO farm :P)
[*]Fixed rematch wrong start bug
[*]Fixed achievement get on loss
[*]Fixed multiplayer positioning problems
[*]Fixed text going out of textboxes[/list]

Please let me know if anything is still wrong :)

Have fun!
